question: Wrestlers who won more than one Olympic title in the same event in non-consecutive Games
sql: SELECT emw.gold_athlete, COUNT(DISTINCT emw.year) AS gold_count FROM event_names_medal_winners emw JOIN edition_sport_medal esm ON emw.result_id = esm.result_id WHERE esm.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' GROUP BY emw.gold_athlete HAVING gold_count > 1 AND MAX(emw.year) - MIN(emw.year) > 4

question: Wrestlers who won more than one Olympic title in the same event in non-consecutive Games
sql: SELECT a1.athlete_name FROM ( SELECT eam.gold AS athlete_name, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.gold IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT eam.silver, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.silver IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT eam.bronze, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.bronze IS NOT NULL ) a1 JOIN ( SELECT eam.gold AS athlete_name, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.gold IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT eam.silver, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.silver IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT eam.bronze, eam.sport_event, eam.edition_id FROM edition_sport_medal eam WHERE eam.sport_event LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND eam.bronze IS NOT NULL ) a2 ON a1.athlete_name = a2.athlete_name AND a1.sport_event = a2.sport_event AND a1.edition_id < a2.edition_id GROUP BY a1.athlete_name, a1.sport_event HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.edition_id) > 1;

question: Olympic Wrestling Champions in Both Freestyle and Greco-Roman
sql: SELECT ar.athlete_id, ar.as_name FROM athlete_results ar WHERE ar.discipline_sport LIKE '%Wrestling%' AND ar.athlete_id IN ( SELECT a1.athlete_id FROM athlete_results a1 INNER JOIN athlete_results a2 ON a1.athlete_id = a2.athlete_id WHERE a1.discipline_sport LIKE '%Freestyle%' AND a2.discipline_sport LIKE '%Greco-Roman%' AND a1.medal = 'Gold' AND a2.medal = 'Gold' ) GROUP BY ar.athlete_id, ar.as_name;

question: Volleyball players who won more than one Olympic title in the same event in non-consecutive Games
sql: SELECT ar1.athlete_id, ar1.as_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ar1.edition_id) AS medal_count FROM athlete_results ar1 JOIN athlete_results ar2 ON ar1.athlete_id = ar2.athlete_id AND ar1.event = ar2.event AND ar1.edition_id < ar2.edition_id WHERE ar1.discipline_sport LIKE '%Volleyball%' AND ar2.discipline_sport LIKE '%Volleyball%' AND ar1.medal IN ('Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze') AND ar2.medal IN ('Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze') AND (ar1.edition_id - ar2.edition_id) != 4 GROUP BY ar1.athlete_id, ar1.as_name HAVING medal_count > 1;
